build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev && composer dump-autoload && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; echo ====ENV-SUMMARY====; echo COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none) PHP=$(php -v | head -n1); echo DATABASE_URL=[$DATABASE_URL] POSTGRES_URL=[$POSTGRES_URL] POSTGRESQL_URL=[$POSTGRESQL_URL]; echo DB_HOST=[$DB_HOST] DB_PORT=[$DB_PORT] DB_DATABASE=[$DB_DATABASE] DB_USERNAME=[$DB_USERNAME] PGSSLMODE=[$PGSSLMODE] RESET_PANEN_DATA=[$RESET_PANEN_DATA]; chmod +x scripts/pg_diag.sh || true; mkdir -p storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/framework/cache bootstrap/cache || true; chmod -R 777 storage bootstrap/cache || true; echo ====PG-DIAG-PRE====; ./scripts/pg_diag.sh || true; echo ====CACHE-CLEAR====; rm -rf storage/framework/views/* || true; php artisan view:clear || true; php artisan optimize:clear || true; if [ "$RESET_PANEN_DATA" = "1" ]; then echo ====RESET-PANEN-DATA====; php artisan panen:reset-data --confirm || true; fi; echo ====MIGRATE====; if ! php artisan migrate --force -vvv; then echo ====MIGRATION-FAILED====; ./scripts/pg_diag.sh || true; exit 1; fi; echo ====SEED====; php artisan db:seed --force --no-interaction || true; php artisan storage:link || true; echo ====CACHE-BUILD====; php artisan config:cache || true; if ! php artisan route:cache; then echo route:cache skipped due to closure routes; php artisan route:clear || true; fi; php artisan view:clear || true; echo ====START====; LOG_CHANNEL=stderr php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT'
